title: Design System: Personal OAL builder — Web

motion.name: control-colors
motion.purpose: Buttons/download-style controls only, under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Consequential action; disabled until its prerequisites are met.
components.css: .ds-button-primary{font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:550;background:#222827;color:#f3f5f4;border:1px solid #3a4340;border-radius:6px;padding:11px 16px;min-height:44px;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;text-align:center;line-height:1.4;background:var(--accent,#99d8b6);color:#101c15;border-color:var(--accent,#99d8b6);}.ds-button-primary:hover{background:#2b3430;border-color:#66776e;}.ds-button-primary:disabled{background:#1a1e1c;border-color:#3a4240;color:#9ba49f;cursor:not-allowed;}.ds-button-primary:hover{background:#b1e5ca;border-color:var(--accent,#99d8b6);}.ds-button-primary:disabled{background:#2d4437;border-color:#2d4437;color:#aec1b6;}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #99d8b6;outline-offset:4px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-button-primary{transition:background-color .12s ease-out,border-color .12s ease-out;}}

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary{font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:550;background:#222827;color:#f3f5f4;border:1px solid #3a4340;border-radius:6px;padding:11px 16px;min-height:44px;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;text-align:center;line-height:1.4;}.ds-button-secondary:hover{background:#2b3430;border-color:#66776e;}.ds-button-secondary:disabled{background:#1a1e1c;border-color:#3a4240;color:#9ba49f;cursor:not-allowed;}.ds-button-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #99d8b6;outline-offset:4px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-button-secondary{transition:background-color .12s ease-out,border-color .12s ease-out;}}

components.name: Session action
components.description: Smaller session-reset action; the application requests confirmation.
components.css: .ds-button-session{font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:550;background:#222827;color:#f3f5f4;border:1px solid #3a4340;border-radius:6px;padding:11px 16px;min-height:44px;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;text-align:center;line-height:1.4;font-size:13px;background:transparent;}.ds-button-session:hover{background:#2b3430;border-color:#66776e;}.ds-button-session:disabled{background:#1a1e1c;border-color:#3a4240;color:#9ba49f;cursor:not-allowed;}.ds-button-session:hover{background:transparent;}.ds-button-session:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #99d8b6;outline-offset:4px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-button-session{transition:background-color .12s ease-out,border-color .12s ease-out;}}

components.name: Text field
components.description: Recessed full-width input with visible label; validation uses the shared alert and native form constraints.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-play-version">Highest version code in Google Play</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-play-version" type="text" inputmode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]+" required>
components.css: .ds-label{font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;color:#f3f5f4;font-size:14px;font-weight:550;display:block;margin:18px 0 8px;}.ds-input{font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:15px;width:100%;padding:11px 12px;min-height:44px;color:#f3f5f4;background:#111415;border:1px solid var(--line,#626e68);border-radius:6px;caret-color:var(--accent,#99d8b6);}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #99d8b6;outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Step indicator
components.description: Non-interactive ordered progress list. Active step is identified with aria-current, not a link.
components.html:
1. 1 Latest release
  2. 2 Your identity
  3. 3 Save & build
  4. 4 Downloads

components.name: Work panel and status
components.description: Single flat work area with a bordered polite status region; no elevation shadow.
components.html:
Checking latest public release…

Check the latest release

The builder checks GitHub, then downloads and checks the matching public template from this site. Older releases are not used.

components.name: Notice
components.description: Amber explanatory caution, not a decorative badge.
components.html: This is a web-builder backup, not a desktop/JKS backup. Never create a new identity to update an existing Play app.

components.name: Error alert
components.description: Focusable error region; app code reveals and focuses it on failure.
components.html: Passwords do not match. Enter the same backup password in both fields.

narrative.overview: The implemented interface inherits the desktop builder’s charcoal background, flat dark panel and mint actions. It is a restrained task interface: a persistent numbered step rail, one active work panel and direct explanatory copy, without marketing imagery or ornamental assets.
keyCharacteristics: Dark tonal separation with fine borders, not shadows.
System typography, readable labels and explicit status/error text.
Mint reserved for actions, current progress, links and focus.
dos: Do preserve the inherited charcoal/mint palette and flat bordered surfaces.
Do retain visible labels, keyboard focus, current-step semantics and textual status/error feedback.
Do let long forms and identifiers wrap or scroll without hiding essential instructions.
donts: Don't turn the step indicator into navigation or imply a disabled backup gate is complete.
Don't add decorative imagery, shadow-based elevation or a competing visual identity to this extraction.
Don't place internal review dispositions or raw design-decision metadata in the shipping interface.
